It is an exclusive project of only 8 Luxury Villas in the center of the fashionable town on the island of Ibiza, Santa Eulària des Riu. It is located a few meters from the town hall square and 5 minutes walk from the beach and the marina.
Our project is designed following the Ibizan aesthetic, making use of noble materials such as local stone, oak wood and white lime mortar. It is, at the same time, a modern project with large windows, to capture all the light of this wonderful island. Private pool, chill-out area and native garden.

reels.caption:
One house, one fjord, complete silence 🖤

📍 Faroe Islands
A single black turf-roof cabin sits alone where an electric-green hillside meets a deep, dark fjord. No roads, no other houses in sight — just one home facing the water, with a storm building overhead like it does most days here. This is what isolation looks like when it's beautiful instead of lonely 🌿⛈️
#faroeislands #travel #cinematic #hiddengem #isolation
